title: cgv-data generated dataset manifest
description: Every published dataset version declares itself with a manifest.json. The manifest is the only thing that makes a file in this repository legitimate: a file not listed in checksums is undeclared, and an undeclared file must not ship.

datasetVersion.description: Semantic version of this dataset release. Immutable once published.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the consumer-facing file format. Consumers reject unsupported values rather than guessing.

generated.description: True for machine-produced artifacts. Must be true for anything published by an exporter.

doNotEdit.description: True means: edit the source repository and re-publish. Hand-editing this dataset is a contract violation.

sourceRepository.description: Repository that owns the editable truth, e.g. 'La-Biblia-Fiel/Biblia-LBF'.

sourceCommit.description: Exact commit SHA in sourceRepository that produced these bytes.

generator.description: Name of the exporter that produced this release.

generatorVersion.description: Version of that exporter, so a build can be reproduced.

sourceRevisionIds.description: Revision ids bound by the source release manifest.

sourceEditions.description: Source editions this dataset was built from, e.g. TR1894, OSHB/WLC.

scope.description: What is included, and how much of it is approved.

atomicWith.description: Dataset ids published in the same atomic release. LBF text and LBF alignment must list each other.

checksums.description: Every published file in this version, path relative to the version directory, mapped to its sha256. A file present but unlisted is undeclared.
